definitions.gloss: to take the plunge, to make a decisive move
definitions.explanation: To make a firm decision to do something significant, especially after hesitation.
To push off the ground with one's foot to jump or leap, as in athletics.

examples.japanese: ⟦ついに→ついに：02360_tsuini⟧⟦{転職|てんしょく}→転職：04557_tenshoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{踏|ふ}み{切|き}った。
examples.english: I finally took the plunge and changed jobs.
It takes courage to take the plunge into starting a business.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{悩|なや}んだ→悩む：02380_nayamu⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧、⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦{移住|いじゅう}→移住：13752_ijuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{踏|ふ}み{切|き}る⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: After years of deliberation, I decided to take the plunge and move abroad.

examples.japanese: ⟦{左足|ひだりあし}→左足：27500_hidariashi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{踏|ふ}み{切|き}って⟦{跳|と}んだ→跳ぶ：19597_tobu⟧。
examples.english: I pushed off with my left foot and jumped.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{力強|ちからづよ}く→力強い：03119_chikarazuyoi⟧{踏|ふ}み{切|き}って⟦{跳|と}んだ→跳ぶ：19597_tobu⟧。
examples.english: The athlete pushed off powerfully and jumped.

examples.japanese: {踏|ふ}み{切|き}る⟦{位置|いち}→位置：11554_ichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ずれて→ずれる：03370_zureru⟧、⟦ファウル→ファウル：06584_fauru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦しまった→しまう：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: The takeoff position was off, and it ended up being a foul.

notes:
USAGE: {踏|ふ}み{切|き}る is a compound verb combining ⟦{踏|ふ}む→踏む：01197_fumu⟧ (to step on) and ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to cut, completion). The figurative sense (sense 1) of making a decisive commitment is more common in everyday use.

TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧). Takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ for the action one decides to take.

ASPECT: {踏|ふ}み{切|き}った emphasizes completion of the decision. {踏|ふ}み{切|き}れない indicates inability to make the decision.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{決断|けつだん}→決断：13250_ketsudan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{踏|ふ}み{切|き}る (to make a firm decision)
- ⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{踏|ふ}み{切|き}る (to take the plunge to purchase)
- ⟦{独立|どくりつ}→独立：03488_dokuritsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{踏|ふ}み{切|き}る (to decide to become independent)

RELATED: ⟦{踏切|ふみきり}→踏切：06493_fumikiri⟧ (railroad crossing) uses the same kanji but is a different word.

NOTE: Often used with ⟦ついに→ついに：02360_tsuini⟧ or ⟦{思|おも}い{切|き}って→思い切る：04590_omoikiru⟧ to emphasize the decisiveness.
